title: 第25章 修炼九幽魂典第26章 魂力突破二品
content_zh:
陆宸并不知道陆乾父子的勾当，也不想知道。
外界过了半个时辰，混沌珠世界的陆宸脸上浮现出喜色，因为他终于通过九幽魂典凝练出了第一个魂奴。
这个魂奴通体漆黑，外型像一个骷髅头，一凝练出来，它就像一只饿鬼，尖叫着咬向陆宸的灵魂体。
“嘶～”
魂奴一口咬下去，陆宸再也笑不出来了。
灵魂体的感知比肉身灵敏数十倍，魂奴一口咬下一块灵魂，疼得他直抽了一口凉气。
紧接着，他的额头青筋暴起，冷汗直冒，整个人更是忍受不了疼痛直挺挺的倒了下去，不断抽搐。
“妹的，这也太痛苦了。”
陆宸直骂娘，直到这一刻，他才明白天养生那个家伙的恐怖实力不是白来的。
这自残，一般人根本受不了。
“不吃苦中苦，怎能成为人上人，要是练不死，就往死里练。”
想到将来要找到天养生赢回九天之战中丢失的面子，陆宸大吼着鼓励自己。
与此同时，他加快了九幽魂典的运转，魂奴吃下灵魂体咀嚼的速度也变得越来越快。
灵魂碎片虽然已经进到了魂奴的嘴里，但依旧是陆宸的灵魂，魂奴每咀嚼一口，陆宸都能清楚的体会到噬魂的痛苦。
除了痛苦，陆宸也隐约的察觉到，魂奴在吃掉他的灵魂体以后后会释放出一部分灵魂。
这些被魂奴释放出来的灵魂颜色更澄明清澈，当这些灵魂重塑回主魂时，陆宸发现感知似乎强了一些。
这一发现让陆宸心神一振，陆宸意识到，修炼九幽魂典其实就是在万鬼噬魂中蜕变。
于是乎，在接下来的时间里，陆宸一边痛苦骂娘，一边疯狂运转九幽魂典，享受着痛并快乐着的感觉。
灵晶堆里，看到陆宸能够坚持下来，鼠爷很是欣慰，它自己也加快了吃灵晶的速度，疯狂糟蹋陆宸的灵晶。
混沌珠世界太阳东升西落，转眼过了两天。

两天时间，陆宸的灵魂体不知道被魂奴反复吃了几遍，魂奴的数量也由开始的一个变成了三个。
通过这两天的修行，陆宸发现不仅本源魂体可以凝练魂奴，魂奴自身在吃了他大量废魂后也能通过分裂创造魂奴。
这三个魂奴，只有一个是这两天主魂凝练出来的，另外两个是由最初那个魂奴一分为二变的。
这两天，除了魂奴数量的增加，陆宸的灵魂体也在一遍又一遍的摧残中小了二分之一。
不过，陆宸对此却非常高兴，因为灵魂体虽然小了，但却凝练和真实了很多，他的魂力也强大了不少。
以陆宸修行多年的经历看，修炼两天九幽魂典，这效果完全能够赶得上上一世他修炼一个月了。
“臭小子，你爹和你四叔往这边来了。”
这一天，陆宸正在享受欲仙欲死的滋味，鼠爷的声音从远处传来。
闻言，神经麻木的陆宸立刻结束修行，然后晕晕乎乎的换上一套干净的衣服，回到了外界。
一会儿，陆毅和陆狂火急火燎的走了进来，而陆宸则是在揉着被九幽魂典折磨得疼痛不已的脑袋。
看到陆宸这副模样，陆毅一脸关心的问道：“宸儿，你这是怎么了，看上去很是疲惫。”
陆宸睁开眼，晃了晃脑袋，随后咧嘴笑着道：“爹，孩儿没事，只是修炼得猛了些，有点累。”
content_en:
Lu Chen didn't know about the activities of Lu Qian and his son, and he didn't want to know.
Half an hour passed in the outside world, and Lu Chen from the Chaos Pearl World showed joy on his face, because he finally condensed the first soul slave through the Nine Nether Soul Code.
This soul slave was completely black and looked like a skull. Once it was condensed, it was like a hungry ghost, screaming and biting at Lu Chen's soul body.
"Hiss~"
The soul slave took one bite, and Lu Chen couldn't laugh anymore.
The perception of the soul body is dozens of times more sensitive than that of the physical body. The soul slave bit off a piece of soul, which made him gasp in pain.
Immediately afterwards, veins popped up on his forehead and he broke out in cold sweat. He couldn't bear the pain and fell straight down, twitching continuously.
"Sister, this is too painful."
Lu Chen kept scolding his mother. It was only at this moment that he realized that Tian Yangsheng's terrifying strength was not in vain.
Most people simply cannot bear this kind of self-mutilation.
"How can you become a master if you don't endure hardships? If you can't practice to death, practice to death."
Thinking of finding Tian Yangsheng in the future to win back the face lost in the Nine Heavens War, Lu Chen yelled to encourage himself.
At the same time, he sped up the operation of the Nine Nether Soul Code, and the soul slave chewed the soul body faster and faster.
Although the soul fragments had entered the soul slave's mouth, they were still Lu Chen's soul. With every bite the soul slave chewed, Lu Chen could clearly feel the pain of soul-eating.
In addition to the pain, Lu Chen also vaguely noticed that the soul slave would release part of his soul after eating his soul body.
The colors of these souls released by the soul slaves were clearer and clearer. When these souls were reshaped back to the main soul, Lu Chen found that his perception seemed to be stronger.
This discovery refreshed Lu Chen's mind, and Lu Chen realized that cultivating the Nine Ghost Soul Canon was actually transforming into the soul-devouring ghosts.
Therefore, in the following time, Lu Chen cursed his mother in pain while running the Nine Nether Soul Code crazily, enjoying the feeling of pain and happiness.
In the pile of spiritual crystals, Master Mouse was very pleased to see that Lu Chen could persevere. He also speeded up his eating of spiritual crystals, frantically destroying Lu Chen's spiritual crystals.
The sun rose in the east and set in the west in the Chaos Pearl World, and two days passed in the blink of an eye.
In two days, Lu Chen's soul body was eaten by the soul slaves several times, and the number of soul slaves also increased from one to three.
Through these two days of practice, Lu Chen discovered that not only the original soul body could condense soul slaves, but the soul slaves themselves could also create soul slaves through division after eating a large amount of his waste souls.
Of these three soul slaves, only one was condensed from the master soul in the past two days, and the other two were split into two from the original soul slave.
In the past two days, in addition to the increase in the number of soul slaves, Lu Chen's soul body has also shrunk by one-half due to the repeated torture.
However, Lu Chen was very happy about this, because although his soul body was smaller, it was much more condensed and real, and his soul power was also much stronger.
Judging from Lu Chen's many years of training experience, after two days of practicing the Nine Ghost Soul Canon, the effect can be compared to what he had practiced for a month in his previous life.
"You brat, your father and your fourth uncle are coming this way."
On this day, Lu Chen was enjoying the feeling of ecstasy when Master Shu's voice came from a distance.
Hearing this, Lu Chen, who was numb, immediately ended his practice, then put on a set of clean clothes in a daze and returned to the outside world.
After a while, Lu Yi and Lu Kuang walked in anxiously, while Lu Chen was rubbing his head that was in pain from the Nine Nether Soul Code.
Seeing Lu Chen's appearance, Lu Yi asked with concern: "Chen'er, what's wrong with you? You look very tired."
Lu Chen opened his eyes, shook his head, then grinned and said, "Dad, the kid is fine. He just practiced a little harder and is a little tired."
